full_log_region_semantics.coverage: Observed complete region of supplied log artifact, not instrumentation completeness or request-success standard
full_log_region_semantics.timestamp_unit: source context schema int seconds; no timing inference beyond saved alignment

metric.values: Raw *_workload; no fill/scaling/drop/alias; metric units not inferred
metric.coverage: Every grid row exists; a null workload is missing, not zero

trace.entity_field: literal serviceName; null has separate code; no alias inferred

alignment.zero_count: No events observed in artifact bin; completeness unknown
alignment.bin: [metric_time, metric_time+1) using source timestamp; no smoothing

trace.root_definition: parentSpanID null, empty, 0+, None or null, case insensitive (T-002)
trace.request_count_semantics: OPEN: distinct observed traceIDs/root traceIDs are proxies, not confirmed external requests; a trace can appear in several seconds/services

status_code.interpretation: Raw values only; no error/status semantics assumed

hash_index.row_index: 0-based original parquet row order, implicit array position; no sort/dedup
hash_index.digest: SHA256 of exact message UTF-8 bytes without strip/normalization
hash_index.missing_message: Separate bool mask; zero digest placeholder is not a real message hash
hash_index.readback: Hash-check original logs.parquet; use row index and compare SHA256 of original message
